KIKUmap is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that tracks your AI chat sessions — it shows which Claude, ChatGPT and Claude Code chats are running, finished or stuck waiting for approval, and lays pinned ones out as a draggable mind map with topics, colors and tags. Native Swift AppKit, no Electron, no account, all data local. tang1693.github.io/KIKUmap/

同时开着十几个 Claude、ChatGPT 会话，最头疼的不是任务太多，而是根本记不清哪个已经完成、哪个还在运行、哪个正等着你确认。

KIKUmap 是一款 macOS 菜单栏工具，把分散的 AI 会话整理成一张可视化思维导图。

🧠 会话地图：将置顶会话按照主题组织起来，不再需要反复切换窗口。

⚡ 实时状态：运行中、已完成、等待确认的任务一眼就能分辨。

⏱️ 耗时统计：查看不同会话的运行时间，了解任务进展。

📤 对话导出：可以导出 AI 对话，方便整理和留档。

🔒 本地优先：使用纯 Swift 开发，零依赖，数据全部保存在本机。

⭐ 已有 771 Star。

如果你习惯同时让多个 AI Agent 干活，真正需要的可能不是再开一个聊天窗口，而是一个能看清所有任务进度的控制面板。

AI 会话越来越多，管理它们也应该有自己的工具。

Your AI chats can announce when they're done. Someone finally built the missing Mac app.

Kikumap is a free, open-source Mac menu-bar app that tracks Claude and ChatGPT chats.

• See which pinned chats are running, finished unread or waiting for approval.
• Hear a completion sound, or have it announce which chat finished.
• Drag chats onto a mind map grouped by work, home or side projects.

$0. 382 GitHub stars in 7 days. Works on Intel and Apple silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. Everything stays on your Mac; it needs Accessibility permission and a one-time "Open Anyway" approval.
